request.objective: Start at https://www.qatarairways.com/. Find the weight of baggage allowance for economy class on Qatar Airways.

response.result:
On Qatar Airways, Economy baggage allowance by weight is:

**Carry-on:** 1 piece up to **7 kg (15 lb)** — the same for every Economy fare type. Exception: on flights to or from Brazil, Economy passengers may carry 1 piece up to **10 kg (22 lb)**.

**Checked baggage — flights to or from Africa or the Americas (piece concept):**
- Economy Lite: 1 piece up to **23 kg (50 lb)**
- Economy Classic, Convenience and Comfort: 2 pieces, each up to **23 kg (50 lb)**

**Checked baggage — all other destinations (weight concept):**
- Economy Lite: **20 kg (44 lb)**
- Economy Classic: **25 kg (55 lb)**
- Economy Convenience: **30 kg (66 lb)**
- Economy Comfort: **35 kg (77 lb)**

These figures are from the "Baggage allowance per fare type" table on Qatar Airways' baggage allowance page (www.qatarairways.com/en/baggage/allowance.html). The allowance depends on route and fare type, and Silver/Gold/Platinum Privilege Club members and oneworld Emerald/Sapphire/Ruby members get extra allowance on top of these amounts.
